Requirements:
trial_summary from read_data.R

# Library
```{r}
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(lmerTest)
library(performance)
library(Rmisc)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(sjPlot)


pbkrtest.limit = 4001 # Makes it so DF calculations work for this large of a number
```

# Read data
```{r}
# Summarized measures for each individual trial
model_data <- trial_summary %>%
	mutate(
		visibility = as.numeric(visibility),
		visibility_f  = as.factor(visibility),
		Config_Number = factor(Config_Number),
		ID = as.factor(ID)
	)

# Set order from low to high visibility while keeping 150 as the reference/control
model_data$visibility_f <- factor(
  model_data$visibility_f,
  levels = c("25", "30", "40", "55", "150")
)
contrasts(model_data$visibility_f) <- contr.treatment(
  levels(model_data$visibility_f),
  base = 5
)

# Summarized measures combined for each vis. condition
visibility_summary <- visibility_summary %>%
	mutate(
		visibility = as.numeric(visibility),
		visibility_f  = factor(
			visibility,
			levels = c(25, 30, 40, 55, 150)
		),
		ID = as.factor(ID)
	)
```


# Mean Velocity
```{r}
m_vel <- lmer(
	Mean_Velocity ~ visibility_f +
		(1 | ID) +
		(1 | Config_Number) +
		(1 | ID:Config_Number),
	data = model_data,
	REML = TRUE
)

summary(m_vel)
anova(m_vel)
```
```{r}
r2(m_vel)
```

Diagnoses and post-hoc
```{r}
# Residuals
plot(m_vel)

# QQ plot
qqnorm(residuals(m_vel))
qqline(residuals(m_vel))

# EMMs
emm_velocity <- emmeans(m_vel, ~ visibility_f)
emm_velocity

# test every condition against every other
#pairs(emm_velocity, adjust = "tukey")
# test consecutive conditions (25 vs 30, 40 vs 30, etc)
contrast(emm_velocity, method = "consec", adjust = "holm")
# test every condition against control
#contrast(emm_velocity, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 5, adjust = "holm")

plot(emm_velocity)

rm(emm_velocity)
```

# Mean Resets
```{r}
m_reset <- glmer.nb(
	count_reset ~ visibility_f +
		(1 | ID) +
		(1 | Config_Number) +
		(1 | ID:Config_Number),
	data = model_data,
	control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

summary(m_reset)
anova(m_reset)

# Null model for omnibus
m_reset_null <- update(m_reset, . ~ . - visibility_f + 1)
anova(m_reset_null, m_reset)

```
```{r}
r2(m_reset)
```

Diagnoses and post-hoc
```{r}
check_overdispersion(m_reset)

emm_reset <- emmeans(m_reset, ~ visibility_f, type = "response")
emm_reset

# test every condition against every other
#pairs(emm_reset, adjust = "tukey")
# test consecutive conditions (25 vs 30, 40 vs 30, etc)
contrast(emm_reset, method = "consec", adjust = "holm")
# test every condition against control
#contrast(emm_reset, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 5, adjust = "holm")

plot(emm_reset)

rm(emm_reset)
```

# Plots

Combined performance plots with within-subject 95% confidence intervals
```{r performance-plots}
measure_labels <- c(
	Mean_Velocity = "Mean Velocity (m/s)",
	Mean_Resets = "Mean Reset Count",
	Mean_Total_Steering = "Mean Total Steering (deg)",
	Mean_MAAA = "Mean Abs. Angular Acceleration (deg/s^2)"
)

# Prepare plotting data even when the model-preparation chunk has not run.
performance_data <- visibility_summary %>%
	dplyr::mutate(
		visibility = as.numeric(as.character(visibility)),
		visibility_f = factor(visibility, levels = c(25, 30, 40, 55, 150)),
		ID = factor(ID)
	)

# Participant-level values for the individual lines.
plot_input <- performance_data %>%
	dplyr::select(ID, visibility, dplyr::all_of(names(measure_labels))) %>%
	tidyr::pivot_longer(
		cols = dplyr::all_of(names(measure_labels)),
		names_to = "Measure",
		values_to = "Value"
	) %>%

	dplyr::mutate(
		Measure = factor(
			Measure,
			levels = names(measure_labels),
			labels = unname(measure_labels)
		)
	)

# Calculate each measure's CI and combine into plotting data.
plot_CI <- lapply(names(measure_labels), function(measure) {
	Rmisc::summarySEwithin(
		performance_data,
		measurevar = measure,
		withinvars = "visibility_f",
		idvar = "ID",
		conf.interval = 0.95
	) %>%
		dplyr::transmute(
			visibility = as.numeric(as.character(visibility_f)),
			Measure = measure,
			Value = .data[[measure]],
			ci = ci
		)
}) %>%
	dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
	dplyr::mutate(
		Measure = factor(
			Measure,
			levels = names(measure_labels),
			labels = unname(measure_labels)
		)
	)

# Build one panel per measure so each column has its own bottom x-axis.
performance_panels <- lapply(seq_along(measure_labels), function(i) {
	measure_label <- unname(measure_labels[i])
	panel_input <- dplyr::filter(plot_input, Measure == measure_label)
	panel_CI <- dplyr::filter(plot_CI, Measure == measure_label)

	p <- ggplot(panel_input, aes(x = visibility, y = Value)) +
	# participant lines
	geom_line(
		aes(group = ID, color = ID),
		alpha = 0.5
	) +
	geom_point(
		aes(color = ID),
		alpha = 0.6
	) +
	# overall mean
	geom_line(
		data = panel_CI,
		aes(
			x = visibility,
			y = Value,
			group = 1
		),
		color = "black",
		inherit.aes = FALSE
	) +
	geom_point(
		data = panel_CI,
		aes(
			x = visibility,
			y = Value
		),
		color = "black",
		inherit.aes = FALSE
	) +
	# within-subject 95% CI
	geom_errorbar(
		data = panel_CI,
		aes(
			x = visibility,
			ymin = Value - ci,
			ymax = Value + ci
		),
		color = "black",
		inherit.aes = FALSE
	) +
	# styling
	scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(25, 30, 40, 55, 150)) +
	labs(
		tag = paste0("(", letters[i], ")"),
		x = "Visibility (m)",
		y = measure_label,
		color = "Participant"
	) +
	theme_bw() +
	theme(
		legend.position = "none",
		plot.tag = element_text(face = "italic"),
		plot.tag.position = "topleft"
	)

	# The first two panels form the top row.
	if (i <= 2) {
		p <- p + theme(
			axis.title.x = element_blank(),
			axis.text.x = element_blank(),
			axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
		)
	}
	p
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(performance_panels, ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE) 

```




# Random slope comparison: ID

```{r}
m2_vel <- lmer(
	Mean_Velocity ~ visibility_f +
		(1 | Config_Number) +
		(1 | ID:Config_Number) +
        (1 + visibility_f | ID),
	data = model_data,
	REML = TRUE
)

m2_reset <- glmer.nb(
	count_reset ~ visibility_f +
		(1 | Config_Number) +
		(1 | ID:Config_Number) +
        (1 + visibility_f | ID),
	data = model_data,
	control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

m2_maaa <- lmer(
	MAAA ~ visibility_f +
		(1 | Config_Number) +
		(1 | ID:Config_Number) +
        (1 + visibility_f | ID),
	data = model_data,
	REML = TRUE
)

m2_steering <- lmer(
	Total_Steering ~ visibility_f +
		(1 | Config_Number) +
		(1 | ID:Config_Number) +
        (1 + visibility_f | ID),
	data = model_data,
	REML = TRUE
)
```

```{r singularity}
isSingular(m2_vel)
isSingular(m2_reset)
isSingular(m2_maaa)
isSingular(m2_steering)
```
```{r AIC_and_BIC}
# lower aic = better

AIC(m_vel, m2_vel) 
BIC(m_vel, m2_vel)
# m2 lower for both -> see singularity problem

AIC(m_reset, m2_reset)
BIC(m_reset, m2_reset)
# m1 lower for both

AIC(m_MAAA, m2_maaa)
BIC(m_MAAA, m2_maaa)
# m2 has better AIC, m1 better BIC

AIC(m_steering, m2_steering)
BIC(m_steering, m2_steering)
# m2 has better AIC, m1 better BIC

```


# Print summary for models
```{r}
tab_model(
	m_vel,
	m_MAAA,
	m_steering,
	df.method = "satterthwaite",
	show.df = TRUE,
	show.stat = TRUE,
	file = "cont_models.html"
)

tab_model(
	m_reset,
	show.df = TRUE,
	show.stat = TRUE,
	show.loglik = TRUE,
	file = "reset_model.html"
)
```
